hero.name: Taroko Gorge
hero.silhouette: Deep, narrow marble gorge with sheer vertical walls nearly closing overhead and a river running at the bottom

crop: The Swallow Grotto (Yanzikou) section: the narrow gorge, the Liwu River below and the highway cut into the cliff with tunnel openings. Not the whole national park.
orientation: Liwu River runs west to east toward the Pacific; Central Cross-Island Highway follows the gorge wall on one side (verify: which bank in this section)
